Hawaii Packing List

Clothing:
- Swimsuits
- Cover-ups
- Lightweight, breathable clothing
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Sandals
- Light jacket or sweater
- Rain jacket or poncho

Toiletries:
- Sunscreen (SPF 30 or higher)
- Aloe vera gel
- Shampoo and conditioner
- Body wash or soap
- Toothbrush and toothpaste
- Deodorant
- Razor
- Hairbrush or comb
- Hair ties or clips
- Makeup and makeup remover
- Skincare products

Accessories:
- Sunglasses
- Wide-brimmed hat
- Beach bag or tote
- Reusable water bottle
- Snorkel gear (if applicable)
- Waterproof phone case

Electronics:
- Camera (optional)
- Waterproof phone case
- Portable charger
- Waterproof speaker (optional)

Miscellaneous:
- Passport or ID
- Travel documents (itinerary, reservations, etc.)
- Credit cards and cash
- Travel adapter (if needed)
- Waterproof dry bag for wet clothes
- Beach towel or microfiber towel
- Waterproof sunscreen bag
- Travel pillow (optional)
- Book or e-reader (optional)
- Waterproof journal or notebook (optional)
